purpose: Verify that tampering with an authenticated finalized PASS decision invalidates effect authorization.

expected.safe_condition: A persisted PASS decision whose authenticated receipt is modified after finalization must not authorize the protected effect; an untampered control may execute exactly once.

limits: This test measures authenticated decision-receipt integrity and effect gating in MGnarf v1.70 at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not prove confidentiality of receipt storage or resistance to compromise of the trusted receipt key holder.
